pick.name: zsh/bash (macOS, Linux) and PowerShell 7 + Git for Windows (Windows)
pick.what: Use the OS-native POSIX shell; on Windows pair modern PowerShell with Git for Windows
pick.why: Claude Code's Bash tool needs a POSIX shell; these are the supported defaults

alts.name: Nushell
alts.install: brew install nushell | winget install Nushell.Nushell

candidates.name: fish
candidates.verdict: friendly interactive shell; not POSIX; not re-checked

decision: Keep the OS-native shell. On Windows keep Git for Windows installed so Claude's Bash tool works, and add PowerShell 7 for your own use; use WSL2 when the project is Linux-first.

os_notes.macOS: zsh is the default; nothing to install.
os_notes.Windows: Install PowerShell 7 plus Git for Windows; WSL2 is optional but unlocks the Claude sandbox.

verify.note: Shallow check: no neutrality, pricing or licence defect found; not re-fetched.
